summary: Frontend-only smoke test of Bust a Lead completed successfully. All critical checks PASSED: config screen renders with all 10 required testids; clicking cfg-speed-fast and cfg-bid-65 visibly changes the class to include 'bg-cyan-500/20 border-cyan-400 text-cyan-200 neon-cyan' (React onClick + re-render works); after clicking deal-btn the game table renders (NOT blank) with header, seat-W, seat-E, player-hand containing 25 card buttons matching /^card-/; bankroll-W/E/P and stakes-badge visible; rules-btn opens rulebook-modal and close-rules-btn closes it; sound-toggle clickable without crash; action-bar visible with human's auction turn (bid-btn + pass-btn), pass-btn clicked and auction advanced (East won with Hearts trump).

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid='trump-badge' not found on the trump indicator element. The header does display the trump state ('NO TRUMP' during auction, 'Hearts' after auction win), but the containing element lacks the trump-badge testid the review request expected.

action_items: Add data-testid='trump-badge' to the trump indicator element in the Header component (currently visible as 'NO TRUMP'/'Hearts'/etc but missing the testid).
critical_code_review_comments: Overall the smoke test signals are strong: dealing produces a valid 25-card hand, auction flow progresses, and modals open/close cleanly. Only nit is the missing trump-badge testid.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is frontend-only (no /api). Config screen -> deal-btn -> table with 25-card hand renders correctly. Selection styling uses cyan-400/neon-cyan classes. Action bar exposes bid-btn/pass-btn during human auction turn. Trump-badge testid is currently missing on the header trump indicator.
